드라마.x: These days I often watch Korean dramas.
드라마.t: In Korean, 드라마 means any TV series, including comedies and romances.

생각하다.m: to think; to consider; to remember
생각하다.x: I think that movie is interesting.
생각하다.e: 생각 (thought) + 하다 (do); 생각나다 = something comes to mind.

경기장.x: Since it was the weekend, the stadium was really crowded.

가이드.ex: 가이드가 박물관의 역사를 재미있게 설명해 줬어요.
가이드.x: The guide explained the museum's history in a fun way.

볶다.ex: 야채를 기름에 볶아서 밥과 함께 드세요.
볶다.x: Stir-fry the vegetables in oil and eat them with rice.
볶다.e: Root of 볶음 'stir-fried dish' and 볶음밥 'fried rice'.

똑똑.m: knock knock (on a door); drip drip
똑똑.x: Someone is knocking on the door.
똑똑.e: 의성어 (sound word) for light tapping or small drops falling. For drops, the dark-vowel partner 뚝뚝 means bigger, heavier drops.
똑똑.t: Don't confuse it with 똑똑하다 'to be smart', which is an unrelated word.

입국.x: I got in line to go through immigration.

창업.m: starting a business, founding a company
창업.x: After graduating from college, I started a business with a friend.

재채기.x: I caught a cold, so I keep sneezing.
재채기.t: Use 재채기가 나다 or 재채기를 하다; Koreans don't say 'bless you' after a sneeze.

놀리다.ex: 친구들이 제 머리 모양을 보고 놀렸어요.
놀리다.x: My friends made fun of my hairstyle.
놀리다.e: Built on 놀다 'to play' — playing at someone's expense.

형식.x: Please write the report in the set format.
형식.t: 형식적 often means 'just for show': 형식적인 인사 'a perfunctory greeting'.

쌩쌩.x: A cold wind is whooshing outside.
쌩쌩.e: Both 의성어 and 의태어: the whoosh of a strong wind or of something racing past, as in 차들이 쌩쌩 달려요.
쌩쌩.t: Casual 쌩쌩하다 means 'fresh, full of energy': 푹 자서 쌩쌩해요.

펑펑.m: heavily (snow falling); (cry) one's eyes out; (spend) freely; bang bang
펑펑.e: Both a sound word (의성어) for bangs, like fireworks, and a manner word (의태어) for something pouring out in great amounts.
펑펑.t: Also 펑펑 울다 'to cry one's eyes out' and 돈을 펑펑 쓰다 'to spend money like water'.

침.x: My back hurt, so I got acupuncture at a Korean medicine clinic.
침.e: Homonym warning: native 침 means 'saliva, spit.'
침.t: You 'receive' acupuncture with 맞다: 침을 맞다, just like 주사를 맞다 'to get a shot'.

반도체.x: Korea is a country that exports a lot of semiconductors.
반도체.e: Literally 'half-conducting body': it conducts electricity only partly.

주의보.x: A fine-dust advisory was issued this afternoon.
주의보.t: 주의보 (advisory) is one step below 경보 (warning); alerts are 내려지다 (issued) and 해제되다 (lifted).

거부감.x: At first, I had an aversion to spicy food.
거부감.t: Common pattern: N에 거부감이 들다 'to feel resistant to N'.

어차피.forms: 어차피 + clause: 어차피 늦었으니까 천천히 가요
어차피.m: anyway, in any case, either way
어차피.x: We're late anyway, so let's take our time.
어차피.e: Literally 'whether this or that' — the outcome is the same.

다지다.m: to mince, to chop finely; to firm up, to strengthen; to resolve firmly
다지다.x: Mince the garlic finely and add it.

오가다.m: to come and go; to be exchanged (words, ideas)
오가다.x: Various opinions were exchanged at today's meeting.

풀리다.m: to come undone; to be solved; to ease up (tiredness, weather, anger)
풀리다.x: Taking a warm bath relieved my fatigue.
풀리다.t: Very versatile: 날씨가 풀리다 (weather warms), 화가 풀리다 (anger fades), 일이 잘 풀리다 (things go well).

연대감.m: sense of solidarity, feeling of togetherness
연대감.x: A sense of solidarity grew as we overcame hardships together.

권위자.ex: 그는 뇌 과학 분야의 최고 권위자예요.
권위자.x: He is the top authority in the field of brain science.

획일적.ex: 획일적인 교육은 학생들의 창의력을 떨어뜨릴 수 있습니다.
획일적.x: One-size-fits-all education can weaken students' creativity.
획일적.e: Literally 'drawn to one line' — everything made the same.
획일적.t: Pronounced [회길쩍]; usually critical, like 획일적인 교육 or 획일적인 기준.

착착.ex: 결혼 준비가 계획대로 착착 진행되고 있어요.
착착.x: The wedding preparations are moving along smoothly according to plan.
착착.e: Mimetic: think of things clicking into place one by one.
착착.t: Don't mix up: 착착 is plans progressing; 척척 is a person handling things skillfully.

중구난방.m: everyone talking at once, disorganized discussion
중구난방.x: At the meeting, all kinds of opinions poured out in a jumble.
중구난방.e: Literally 'a crowd's mouths are hard to block'.

마이동풍.m: in one ear and out the other; turning a deaf ear
마이동풍.x: No matter how much advice you give him, it goes in one ear and out the other.
마이동풍.e: Literally 'an east wind blowing past a horse's ear'; the horse doesn't care.
마이동풍.t: Native equivalent: 쇠귀에 경 읽기 'reading scripture into a cow's ear.'

소년원.ex: 그는 소년원에서 나온 뒤 새로운 삶을 시작했어요.
소년원.x: After getting out of juvenile detention, he started a new life.

청강.m: auditing (a class), sitting in on a lecture
청강.x: May I audit a class in another department?
청강.t: 수강 means officially taking a course for credit; 청강 means sitting in without credit.

자유 의지.x: Do humans really have free will?

각자도생.x: The economy is tough, so it's every man for himself.
각자도생.e: Literally 'each seeks his own way to live'.
각자도생.t: Pronounced [각짜도생]. A current-affairs word, usually critical of a society where people feel they can rely on no one but themselves.

종속변인.x: The dependent variable in this experiment is the height of the plants.
종속변인.e: Literally 'subordinate changing factor' — it depends on the independent variable.

함.m: wedding gift box (sent by the groom's family to the bride's)
함.ex: 결혼식 전날 밤에 신랑 친구들이 함을 지고 왔어요.
함.x: The night before the wedding, the groom's friends came carrying the gift box.
함.e: A box with the marriage letter and silk; friends carry it shouting '함 사세요!'
함.t: Collocations: 함을 지다 (carry it on the back) and 함을 받다 (receive it).

부질없다.ex: 이미 지난 일을 후회해 봐야 부질없어요.
부질없다.x: It's pointless to regret what's already past.
부질없다.e: Often used about regrets and wishes: 부질없는 욕심, 부질없는 생각.
부질없다.t: Pronounced [부지럽따]: the ㄹ links to the next syllable.

업사이클링.ex: 버려진 현수막으로 업사이클링 가방을 만드는 회사가 있어요.
업사이클링.x: There's a company that makes upcycled bags from discarded banners.
업사이클링.e: From English 'upcycling'; purists prefer the Korean term 새활용.

가시화.ex: 정부 정책의 효과가 점점 가시화되고 있어요.
가시화.x: The effects of the government's policy are gradually becoming visible.
가시화.t: 가시화되다 means results become visible; for data visualization, 시각화 is more common.
